name: Mountain Climber
steps: Start in a straight high-plank position on the floor with your palms directly beneath your shoulders, core braced, and legs extended behind you.
Drive one knee rapidly forward toward your chest while keeping the opposite foot planted behind you.
Push that foot back to the plank position while simultaneously driving the opposite knee forward.
Continue alternating knees in a running rhythm, then slow down and step your feet in to finish.
tips: Keep your hips low and level rather than bouncing them high toward the ceiling.
Press firmly into the floor with your hands so your shoulders remain stacked over your wrists.
